generation.notes: The final source consists of one 8-second original generation extended to 15 seconds and then 22 seconds by the same Veo 3.1 model using the preceding video bytes as input. The 22-second output nevertheless contained AAC audio, which was removed from the final asset. Prompt enhancement was enabled; prompts recorded here are the submitted prompts, not claimed provider rewrites. Seeds do not guarantee determinism with prompt enhancement.
